notes.title: Update 4
notes.notes:
Here is a new update for you!
We are still here, and we put a lot of time and effort into our big update 2020 during the lock down to make a rapid progress. We still need time to make the game ready for Early Access in 2021! But for now, we keep spending a lot of time developing & preparing the game. We will give you some more updates, soon! 😊
Stay tuned & healthy guys!

notes.title: Update 3 - 10/30/2019
notes.notes:
[i][b]Hey! We are back with an update after a long while. We promoted the game on different conferences and shows. 
We keep working on the game. Here are some fixes and updates. A bigger update will follow.[/b][/i]

[h1]InGame[/h1]
[b]Implemented [/b]
- partial controller support
- map update 'tutorial section'
- updated animations

[b]Others[/b]
- event preparations (demo)
- bug fixing
- intro fixed
- updated command list


[h1]Shop Update[/h1]
- short description
- main description
- new title image/capsule image
...

Leave us a comment and tell us if you like the new look of our Steam page. :)
Thx~

notes.title: Update 2 - 05/16/19
notes.notes:
[b]Update 2 [/b]

Hey! We worked a lot on the project the last months to improve the game and implemented some of the suggestions from the first testers.

[list]
[*] demo area playable + bug fixes
[*] performance improvement
[*] realized some important suggestions from our dear testers (AMAZE)
[*] new voice commands 
[*] command list now available - command: 'show commands'

[h1][b]Upcoming Event[/b][/h1]

Preparing for Game Access Conf. and Festival in Brno, Czech Republic (05/24/19 - 05/26/19)

[/list]
